activities.name: Braga Street Heritage Walk
activities.description: Stroll the 1920s Dutch colonial streetscape of Jalan Braga — art-deco shopfronts, the Grand Hotel Preanger, and Braga Permai cafe unchanged since 1918. The most atmospheric colonial boulevard outside Kota Tua.

activities.name: Gedung Sate
activities.description: West Java's iconic 1920 government building — named after the satay skewer-shaped pinnacle on its roof. Dutch Nieuwe Bouwen meets Sundanese ornament. The Governor's office is open for guided tours on weekdays.

activities.name: Saung Angklung Udjo
activities.description: UNESCO-recognised workshop and performance space for angklung bamboo music. Daily afternoon shows feature village children performing traditional Sundanese songs. Visitors join in — surprisingly compelling even for sceptics.

activities.name: Dago Highland Trail
activities.description: A 7km loop through the pine forests above Dago Atas — paved at the start, then gravel track to the viewpoint. On clear mornings the Bandung basin spreads 700m below you, ringed by volcanic peaks. Start before 8am.

activities.name: Observatorium Bosscha
activities.description: The southern hemisphere's oldest major telescope — a 1923 Dutch refractor perched at 1,310m on the Lembang plateau above Bandung. Public tours Tue and Thu evenings; weekend daytime visits available.

activities.name: Factory Outlet Shopping, Dago
activities.description: Bandung is Indonesia's garment manufacturing capital. Jalan Dago and Jalan Riau are lined with factory outlets selling brand-surplus exports at 30–70% below retail — Adidas, Gap, Zara, Polo, and local designs.

activities.name: Kartika Sari Lapis Legit
activities.description: Bandung's most beloved bakery brand. Their lapis legit (Dutch spiced layered cake) is the city's definitive oleh-oleh — 24 layers of beurre noisette, cardamom, and clove. Queue at the Dago branch for fresh bake.

activities.name: Batagor Isan — Sundanese Dumplings
activities.description: The original Bandung batagor stall that the city claims invented the dish. Crispy fish-tofu dumplings served with peanut sauce and kecap manis. Cash only, counter seating, perpetual queue — worth it.

activities.name: Sari Sunda Sundanese Feast
activities.description: Traditional Sundanese rice table dining — lalab (fresh raw vegetables), pepes ikan (fish steamed in banana leaf), ayam goreng, and sambal. Served in bamboo steamers on a raised bamboo platform. Best lunch in the city.

activities.name: Hotel Savoy Homann
activities.description: An Art Deco masterpiece on Jalan Asia Afrika (1939), directly opposite Gedung Merdeka where the 1955 Bandung Conference was held. Sukarno, Nehru, and Ho Chi Minh all stayed here. 148 rooms, colonial courtyard pool.

activities.name: Grand Hotel Preanger
activities.description: A 1929 Dutch colonial-modernist hotel on Braga, designed by C.P. Wolff Schoemaker. The Brasserie restaurant serves rijsttafel (Indonesian rice table) on Sundays. 188 rooms, original terrazzo floors intact.

activities.name: Ciater Natural Hot Springs
activities.description: Sulphurous hot springs fed by Tangkuban Perahu volcano, 35km north of Bandung. Multiple pool tiers from 38–42°C. Surrounded by tea plantations — combine with a Ciater tea factory tour for a full day.

activities.name: Tangkuban Perahu Volcano
activities.description: Active stratovolcano 28km north of Bandung — you drive to the crater rim (2,084m). Walk the Kawah Ratu and Kawah Domas crater paths for close-up views of volcanic vents. Check activity status before visiting.

activities.name: Bandung Distro Culture
activities.description: Bandung invented the Indonesian 'distro' — independent streetwear labels born in backrooms that are now national brands. Blackjack, Cosmic, Ouval Research on Jalan Trunojoyo and Jalan Aceh. Unique designs, low prices.

activities.name: Braga Nightlife Strip
activities.description: After 9pm Braga transforms: jazz bars, craft beer spots, and rooftop lounges fill the Art Deco blocks. B.A.T.S. Bar at Savoy Homann and the rooftop at Crowne Plaza offer the most atmospheric options.
